scope: Implementation follow-up after the 2026-09-27 media freeze; existing unsent pending image discovery for news absent from a complete projection.

before.note: Age alone does not remove reviewed news. The real gap is an admitted record absent from a complete projection without a withdrawal; the earlier announcement-expiry fix did not cover it.

resolution.policy: explicit held accounting, not archived automatic search or inferred delivery approval
resolution.guards: Absent from current items and withdrawals; existing pending job; no remote ID, dispatch marker or withdrawal; pending media; not an announcement with its separate expiry path.
resolution.concurrency: Transition re-reads state and commits with CAS; it cannot overwrite a concurrent claim or receipt.
resolution.reappearance: The identical current verified record clears only this specific block and returns to pending, even when verifiedAt, semantic revision and mediaPending are unchanged.
resolution.terminalState: Dispatcher returns existing terminal/block state before the pending-image guard.

validation.coverage: Social state machine, portrait discovery, root-owned pacing integration, and the new absent/retained-expectation/identical-return regression.

limits: This focused follow-up succeeds after the prior full-suite snapshot; it is not a new full-suite or production result. CLI, pacing implementation, visual styling and external runtime were not changed.
